To remove something from its proper place is an abomination to @wDN{Ninurta}.

I am not dear to the man I hold dear. He has profited at my expense while I was flapping my arms like a bird.
I am not dear to the man I hold dear. He took …… into his own hands. Because of him, my hands were filled with dust.
He is fearful, like a man unacquainted with beer.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.02,t.6.1.02.87]{6.1.02.87-88}} Low-quality oxen do not plant seed. He who eats during the harvest is not removing clods.

Let the river expand when there is something in it.

@note{cf. @xref[t.6.1.14,t.6.1.14.62]{6.1.14.62}} The nights are fifty, the days are fifty; but the days of lies are fifty-five.
